Pass means every command exits 0; focused tests report 8/8; the audit reports 97 zones, 41 unique events, 265 finance rows and zero displacement features; CI reports 24 files / 183 tests; governance reports 7/7; hashes match above; and build state remains READY_FOR_REVIEW with no self-approval metadata.

## Open limitations

- The pinned Natural Earth layer is a 2026-09-23 repository artifact, not a backdated official 2025 administrative edition.
- Chad has no historical event row; it remains unknown.
- One conflict coordinate is inconsistent with its country and remains country-level.
- The Conflict Index is checked by immutable hash and recorded sheet inspection; the automated verifier does not parse XLSX internals.
- IDMC displacement is omitted, not synthesized.
- Finance is a pinned transformed projection rather than newly downloaded publisher-native raw files; raw export and incompatible amount aggregation remain prohibited.
- No production baseline was compiled in Prompt 25; this milestone only admits its inputs.

## Diff summary

Prompt 25 now uses the data already in the repository, with citations and executable constraints, instead of requiring an artificial review panel. It adds one owner-decision-linked manifest, validates geometry/source facts, records honest limitations, and leaves final PB2-25 acceptance to the owner's reviewed commit.
